kjv: the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby
mine: the pure spiritual milk, that by it you may grow up into salvation
note: TR omits "eis soterian" (into salvation; P72, Sinaiticus, A, B, C). "Logikon" is "spiritual / rational", not "of the word" (a pun on logos the KJV makes explicit).

mine: a people for his (God's) own possession

note: basileus in a letter to the Roman provinces of Asia Minor is the emperor; also 2:17.
